# BitGo to Integrate WisdomTree Tokenized Money Market Fund into Institutional Custody and Settlement Platform


October 27, 2026 6:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_36834363678064c5e0f064b9fa4d1062/wisdomtree/news/2026-10-27_BitGo_to_Integrate_WisdomTree_Tokenized_Money_812.pdf)


*Eligible BitGo clients will be able to access WisdomTree’s tokenized government money market fund directly through BitGo Bank & Trust’s custody and settlement platform.*


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association (“BitGo Bank & Trust”), an OCC-regulated digital asset trust bank and a subsidiary of BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today announced that eligible institutional clients will be able to access the WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund (“WTGXX” or the “Fund”) directly through BitGo Mint.


The integration brings a tokenized, yield-bearing government money market fund into the institutional digital-asset environment where BitGo clients already custody, settle and manage their assets. Clients will be able to move between cash and WTGXX on-platform, reallocate beneficial interests peer-to-peer through BitGo’s Go Network.


Rather than requiring institutions to move assets across separate platforms and providers, the integration will make WTGXX available within BitGo’s custody and settlement infrastructure alongside digital assets that clients may already hold at BitGo Bank & Trust.


Through BitGo Mint, eligible clients will be able to access WTGXX and submit purchase and redemption instructions through BitGo Bank and Trust, move between USD, supported stablecoins and fund shares without separately onboarding with WisdomTree. WTGXX will join BitGo Mint’s growing suite of supported assets, including USD1 and SoFiUSD.


BitGo Bank & Trust customers holding WTGXX shares will be able to reallocate their beneficial interests in those shares peer-to-peer between eligible BitGo clients via Go Network, BitGo’s settlement network.


“Institutions should not have to move assets across multiple platforms to access tokenized financial products,” said Mike Belshe, CEO and Co-founder of BitGo. “By bringing WisdomTree’s tokenized treasury money market fund into BitGo Mint, eligible clients can subscribe to, hold and transfer fund shares within the same regulated bank environment they already use to manage their digital assets.”


Tokenized money market funds are becoming a core part of institutional treasury management, offering exposure to short-term government instruments and expanded use cases. For BitGo clients, this means the ability to move in and out of yield-bearing WTGXX without leaving their BitGo banking environment when live.


“This is about making institutional cash more productive without making it less available,” said Will Peck, Head of WisdomTree Onchain. “By bringing WTGXX directly into BitGo’s regulated banking and settlement environment, we will give clients a way to access treasury yield, maintain operational liquidity and potentially use their holdings as collateral—all in the place where they already manage their digital assets. That is the promise of tokenization: not simply putting traditional investments onchain, but making them more useful.”


The launch will also expand BitGo’s existing relationship with WisdomTree. BitGo serves as one of the institutional-grade custodial partners for WisdomTree’s digital asset exchange-traded products (ETPs) in Europe, securely storing the ETPs’ underlying cryptocurrencies in cold storage. On-platform purchase and redemption support for WTGXX will build on that relationship, extending it from custody of underlying ETP assets to direct, on-platform access to WTGXX for BitGo’s customers.
